'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Adam Howland DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Adam Howland]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''K SHANNON'S A SUPER ROPS'''. Username '''MASTERJEDIADAM'''. Event field on sheet says World Tournament Day 1 (filed in Day 2 PDF). Line 5 Prison with scribbled system prefix.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire]]
* '''Username:''' MasterJediAdam
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
